title: Beyond performance-wise Contribution Evaluation in Federated Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark measures client contributions to a federated model's trustworthiness, specifically its performance (accuracy), fairness (demographic parity), reliability (tolerance to random noise), and resilience (resistance to adversarial attacks).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
